### 10 boards: 5 full + 5 MIDI-only (USD; the DINs and the screen left out of both)

| | JLC | bought with the order (the user solders) | total | a board |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **one battery order of 10**, 5 of them finished by hand as MIDI-only (no cells, no toggle: R62's pads bridged, no CV jacks; their charger, cell parts and CLK / RST drivers fitted but unused) | 125.95 | 11.19 | **137.14** | 13.71 |
| **two orders**: usb x 5 (MIDI-only) + battery x 5 (full) | 167.76 | 11.19 | **178.95** | 17.90 |

One order saves 41.81 USD (one set of setup / stencil / Extended fees instead of two). The MIDI-only boards from the battery order run from USB through the power path and the LDL1117 (no cell needed); R62 is a DNP 0402 land in that order: a blob or a 0 ohm 0402 bridges it. Shipping: one parcel either way (not counted).

## Sources

- econ_setup: USD 8.24, Economic setup fee, JLCONE test quote with the bare ESP32-S3FN8 (2026-11-10)
- econ_stencil: USD 1.55, Economic stencil, same quote
- nitrogen: USD 0.91, nitrogen reflow, the jank-pcb-mod quote 2026-11-09 (JLC added it; may be optional)
- extended: USD 3.09, per unique Extended part type, same test quote; 'preferred' Extended parts are exempt
- joint: USD 0.0017, per solder joint (JLCPCB's published Economic rate)
- pcb_5: USD 3.3, bare 2-layer 1.6 mm board, 5 pieces, as in the 2026-11-09 quote (87 x 79.5 mm; a smaller board is not dearer)
- pcb_10: USD 5, bare 2-layer 1.6 mm board, 10 pieces: an ESTIMATE, not seen in a quote
- manual_joint: USD 0.0164, manual assembly per joint (1..10,000 joints), Economic and Standard alike, JLCPCB help page updated 2026-10-22
- hand_labor: USD 3.58, hand-soldering labour per order, same page
- std_setup: USD 25.56, Standard PCBA setup, single side, same page (if JLC will not take through-hole parts on Economic)
- std_stencil: USD 8.21, Standard PCBA stencil, single side, same page
- USD to EUR, an ASSUMED rate (not read on the day): check it: 0.86
